name: University College Dublin
description:
University College Dublin is the largest university in Ireland and was founded in 1854 as the Catholic University of Ireland. It was renamed University College Dublin in 1882 and is mostly located at a campus at Belfield to the south of the city centre. There are currently more than 33,000 students including 9,500 international students, making it the most international Irish university.

It has been ranked in the top 200 global universities in the QS World University Rankings and top 250 in the Times Higher Education World University Rankings. In the QS and Times Higher Education national rankings in Ireland, University College Dublin ranks second and third respectively. It has also been named the number one university in Ireland by US News & World for the last two years.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Thinking of studying in Dublin? University College Dublin (UCD) is one of the best choices you have. UCD is Ireland’s biggest university and focuses strongly on research. When you chose UCD, you’re choosing a university that’s well-ranked worldwide and known for great teaching.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: With over 11,500 international students from over 150 countries, you’ll be part of a global student community at UCD. There are more than 70 student societies, offering something for everyone. UCD also maintains a global network through its “UCD Global Centres”, helping you stay connected and supported even beyond Dublin. Plus, you can also join numerous clubs and societies at UCD.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
UCD offers on-campus student residences, including single bedrooms (with private or shared bathrooms), and apartments equipped with shared kitchens and living spaces. Fully catered packages are also available.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
As a research-intensive university, you’ll get access to libraries across many disciplines.

Sports
You’ll find many sports facilities at UCD. These include a full-sized 3G pitch for football and rugby, an indoor sports hall with multiple court options for basketball and badminton, and more.

Laboratory
As a research-intensive university, you’ll get access to specialised labs across many fields.

Cafeteria
The UCD campus has a wide range of cafes and restaurants, so you can always get fresh food and beverages.
